podcast.title: Fabulous Style
podcast.body: Jacques Brel was among the artists who followed the trend of flamboyant style, exhibiting a distinctive and fabulous presence. "Jacques Braille... They all sounded different, but they all had a specific sort of fabulous style about them."

podcast.title: Original Songwriter for "Seasons in the Sun"
podcast.body: Jacques Brel was the original Belgian songwriter of the song "Seasons in the Sun." His initial version focused on a man who was profoundly distraught over his wife's infidelity.
